verdict.rationale: CDP explicitly ships natural-language-oriented AI interfaces: an MCP server exposing every API endpoint as a tool, a Coinbase Wallet MCP for AI assistants to check balances/send/swap/sign via natural language, and an 'Agentic Wallet CLI' whose skills are documented with explicit natural-language trigger phrases ('send money, pay someone, transfer USDC...'). This directly supports operating the product via natural-language commands for an AI-native persona. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs, and no evidence of broader natural-language coverage outside the agentic wallet/MCP skill set.
